summary: Phase 149O.20L.7 -- Class-B Real Host Provisioning Execution. EXECUTION ATTEMPT, STOPPED BEFORE ANY MUTATION. Entered under CHGR chgr-d4343fa51b9743f3abaeb87a881a78b1, independently re-verified at this phase's own entry (not assumed from L.6A): live pcae governance-record inspect/verify re-run, outcome verified, schema_shape/digest_self_consistency/lifecycle_structural_legality all passed; direct field re-read confirmed lifecycle_state=published, selected_option_id=approve, decision_subject names Atilas-MacBook-Pro.local specifically, conditions field itself names its own material-drift invalidation rule (L.5A section 18); no revocation_ref/superseded_by/deprecated_by present; remains the only chgr-*.json record in the repository. Before any preflight, fresh Class-B verifier re-run, rollback-baseline capture, or mutation was attempted, the human governance authority (Atila Madai) issued an explicit, first-person instruction changing the provisioning target: PCAE development remains on the Mac; a physical Dell Ubuntu host (previously hac-dell, 192.168.192.200 -- explicitly excluded as unrelated during L.5A, now explicitly un-excluded by this phase's own human instruction) becomes the current deployment target; PCAE must use its own isolated deployment account and resources on the Dell, separate from any other projects/accounts already on that machine; PCAE is confirmed to remain usable separately per repository, with centralized multi-repository/company governance explicitly deferred to future development. Applying L.5A section 18 literally ("the selected host ... changes" is a named invalidating condition) and given the CHGR's own decision_subject names the Mac specifically, not a host generically, this phase classified this as material target drift: the existing CHGR does not authorize Dell provisioning, and no longer usably authorizes Mac provisioning since the Mac is no longer the intended deployment target. This phase performed NO real host mutation of any kind on either host: no sysadminctl/useradd/dscl-create principal-creation command was run; no Protected Root was created or chmod/chown/ACL-mutated; no venv/interpreter/.pth/launch-configuration file was created or modified; no SSH or other network connection was made to the Dell or to hac-windows; no read-only preflight or verify_class_b_deployment_conformance() re-invocation was performed against the Dell (explicitly reserved by the human instruction to a future, separately governed phase); no CHGR was drafted, published, or reused for the Dell target. The rollback baseline and nine-action mutation plan were never entered, since no mutation was planned against any host this phase retained authority to touch; the existing Mac-specific nine-action plan (L.5/L.5A) is not carried forward to the Dell -- a future Dell-target phase must independently re-derive its own plan (Ubuntu is not macOS: useradd/usermod/POSIX ACLs or setfacl are not sysadminctl/macOS ACLs, and the Protected Root default resolver path is platform-conditional). chgr-d4343fa51b9743f3abaeb87a881a78b1 itself was not modified, revoked, or superseded by this phase (no mutating governance-record command exists for that in this increment besides publish, not invoked) -- it remains on record as a valid, human-elected, now practically-superseded-by-target-change Mac-target authorization, itself now historical. Boundary P: NOT AUTHORIZED for any current target. Boundary C and Boundary A remain explicitly NOT AUTHORIZED. Class-B remains NOT PROVISIONED. HATP remains NOT READY. Runtime independently reconfirmed unchanged (Observed/observe/unavailable). Developer environment (atilamadai account, ~/repos/pcae-harness checkout, .venv) confirmed unchanged; git status --short clean before and after this phase's own work. New, independently authored companion test module -- 24 tests, re-run three consecutive times, 24 passed each run, no flake; also cross-checked against the three most closely related pre-existing Class-B/CHGR phase test modules (149O.20L.5A/6/6A), 91 passed / 2 deselected (pre-existing, session-state-dependent drift in L.5A's own test file, independently reproduced without this phase's changes via a git-stash A/B check, unrelated to any file this phase touches). No provisioning, certification, activation, or CHGR mutation performed or authorized by this phase, on the Mac or the Dell. Recommends exactly one next phase: 149O.20L.7A -- Class-B Target Re-Selection & Dell Read-Only Preflight, which must independently re-derive Dell eligibility, perform the Dell's own first legitimate read-only inspection (not performed by this phase), and capture a new, Dell-specific Boundary-P CHGR before any real Dell mutation may be authorized. Not begun by this phase.
